title: pseudipomoea repens
intro: Pseudipomoea repens, commonly known as Convolvulus repens, is a plant species in the family Convolvulaceae. It is a creeping, prostrate herb with reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Pseudipomoea repens include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and bioactive properties of this plant species.
